verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of React's client bundle size, its dependency count, or any focus on minimal runtime footprint or supply-chain risk. "Use as little or as much React as you need" refers to incremental adoption, not bundle size. The 'use client' boundary only marks which modules ship to the client and depends on frameworks implementing Server Components, so it is an adjacent capability rather than evidence of a small, dependency-light bundle.
